 Tom Rhys Harries is still hard at work promoting his new DC Studios horror thriller movie.
 The 36-year-old Welsh actor was joined by co-stars Naomi Ackie and Max Minhghella on the red carpet at a special screening of their movie Clayface on Monday evening (October 19) held at Vue Leicester Square in London, England.
 31 
 Also in attendance was director James Watkins .
 Earlier in the day, all four attended the photocall for Clayface at the Leake Street Arches, which had been given a Clayface -inspired transformation.
 Last week, Tom , Naomi , and James were in Los Angeles for the world premiere of the movie.
 31 
 What is Clayface about?
 Here’s the synopsis:
 Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
 If you are not aware, this film marks DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre of horror-thriller, and it will be R-rated.
 31 
 31 
 31 
 Here’s some Clayface back story from the comics
 Clayface has been portrayed by several characters in DC Comics, with Basil Karlo and Matt Hagen among the most well-known versions. Basil Karlo was a former Gotham actor whose career collapse fueled his obsession with fame, eventually leading him to become a shapeshifting criminal who could impersonate anyone. Matt Hagen took on another version of Clayface. He was largely depicted as a treasure hunter who gained the ability to transform his body after being exposed to a mysterious substance. Both versions use their shapeshifting abilities to challenge Batman, while also being portrayed as characters struggling with their identities and circumstances.
 Tom will definitely be playing the Matt Hagen version in the new movie.
 31 
 When will Clayface be released?
 Clayface hits theaters on October 23.
